newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Disney executive joins George Town Hldgs.
newsitem.headline: Disney executive joins George Town Hldgs.

text.p: A former executive of United States-based Disney has joined a subsidiary of Malaysia's George Town Holdings Bhd, Datuk Keramat Holdings Bhd said in a statement on Thursday.
George Town is a subsidiary of Datuk Keramat.

"Norman Doerges... has left Disneyland as its executive vice president to join Leavesden Development Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of George Town Holdings to be its president and chief operating officer," said Datuk Keramat.
Leavesden is incorporated in the United Kingdom. The company is the "operator of the U.K.'s first entertainment centre and movie-themed studio tour", said Datuk Keramat.
